chunks: Ali ibn Hatim from Humayd ibn Ziyad said: Abd Allah ibn Ahmad al-Nahiki narrated to us from Ali ibn al-Hasan from Muhammad ibn Ziyad from Abu Khadijah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), when the month of Ramadan arrived, would increase in prayer, and I increase, so you should increase.

key_terms.الصَّلَاة: Prayer (specifically voluntary/night prayers in this context)

ai.seo_question: How did the Prophet and the Imams increase their worship during Ramadan?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith establishes the Sunnah of augmenting *Salat al-Tarawih* and other voluntary prayers specifically upon the arrival of Ramadan, reflecting the Prophet’s (peace be upon him) practice of intensifying devotion during the month of the Quran. The Imam’s (peace be upon him) declaration, 'I increase, so you increase,' underscores the theological importance of emulating the Prophet’s heightened spiritual state, a practice deeply rooted in Shia jurisprudence as a means of drawing closer to Allah during the gates of Heaven are opened.
